facts.name: Single-Deposit Assisted Policy
facts.sentence: The policy is titled Single-Deposit Assisted Survivorship Whole Life Policy.

facts.name: Issuing Company
facts.sentence: The issuing company is Harbor Crest National.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is HCN-SDA-2026-6904.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is April 6, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Structure
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The first insured is Charles Edward Larkin.

facts.name: Birth Date of Charles Larkin
facts.sentence: Charles Edward Larkin was born on January 26, 1956.

facts.name: Age of First Insured
facts.sentence: Charles Edward Larkin is age 70.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Charles Edward Larkin's risk class is Preferred.

facts.name: Second Insured: Susan Marie Larkin
facts.sentence: The second insured is Susan Marie Larkin.

facts.name: Birth Date of Susan Larkin
facts.sentence: Susan Marie Larkin was born on August 19, 1958.

facts.name: Age of Susan Marie Larkin
facts.sentence: Susan Marie Larkin is age 67.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Susan Marie Larkin's risk class is Preferred.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Larkin Family Office, LLC.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The beneficiary is Larkin Descendants Trust.

facts.name: Face Amount: $6M
facts.sentence: The face amount of the policy is $6,000,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The base annual premium is $54,000.

facts.name: Initial Premium Deposit
facts.sentence: An initial deposit of $540,000 was made into the premium deposit account.

facts.name: Initial Deposit Application
facts.sentence: The initial deposit is applied under the premium deposit agreement described in Article II.

facts.name: Survivorship Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a survivorship whole life policy.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The death benefit will be paid only upon the death of the second insured.

facts.name: Post-First Death Continuity
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force after the first death.

facts.name: Post-First Death Continuity
facts.sentence: After the first death, the policy remains in force subject to the premium deposit arrangement.

facts.name: Post-First Death Policy Continuity
facts.sentence: After the first death, the policy remains in force subject to policy values.

facts.name: Post-First Death Policy Continuity
facts.sentence: After the first death, the policy remains in force subject to policy debt.

facts.name: Initial Premium Deposit
facts.sentence: At issue, the owner deposited $540,000 into a premium deposit account administered by Harbor Crest National.

facts.name: Premium Deposit Exclusion
facts.sentence: The premium deposit account is not part of the policy cash value.

facts.name: Separate Agreement Governance
facts.sentence: The premium deposit account is governed by a separate agreement.

facts.name: Annual Premium Withdrawal Mechanism
facts.sentence: Each year, the amount of premium then due may be withdrawn from the premium deposit account and applied to this policy.

facts.name: Interest Rate Determination
facts.sentence: Interest on the premium deposit account will be credited at a rate declared by Harbor Crest National.

facts.name: Interest Rate Regulation
facts.sentence: Interest on the premium deposit account is subject to any minimum required by law.

facts.name: Post-Deposit Premium Responsibility
facts.sentence: If the premium deposit account is exhausted, future premiums remain due directly from the owner.

facts.name: Interest Rate on Deposit Account
facts.sentence: Interest on the premium deposit account will be credited at a rate declared by the insurer.

facts.name: Interest Rate Limitation
facts.sentence: The interest rate applied to the premium deposit account is subject to any minimum required by law.

facts.name: Premium Payment Continuation After Exhaustion
facts.sentence: If the premium deposit account is exhausted, future premiums remain due directly from the policyowner.

facts.name: Termination via Separate Agreement
facts.sentence: The policyowner may terminate the premium deposit arrangement in accordance with the separate agreement.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The death benefit equals the face amount plus any paid-up additions.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions & Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Any paid-up additions are included in the calculation of the death benefit.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Policy debt is subtracted from the sum of the face amount and paid-up additions to calculate the death benefit.

facts.name: Unused Deposit After Second Death
facts.sentence: Any amount remaining in the premium deposit account at second death is not added to the policy death benefit.

facts.name: Leftover Funds Exception
facts.sentence: The exception to adding leftover funds to the death benefit occurs when the separate deposit agreement provides otherwise.

facts.name: Proof of Dual Deaths Required
facts.sentence: Proof of both deaths is required to trigger the death benefit payout.

facts.name: Beneficiary Verification Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of beneficiary entitlement is required to trigger the death benefit payout.

facts.name: Participating Policy Status
facts.sentence: This policy is a participating policy.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends for this policy are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Dividends Purchase Paid-Up Additions Automatically
facts.sentence: Unless modified by the owner, dividends will automatically purchase paid-up additions.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Increase Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Paid-up additions increase the death benefit.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Increase Cash Value
facts.sentence: Paid-up additions increase the cash value of the policy.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Policy loans are available after one full policy year has passed since issuance.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Amount Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is equal to 90% of the net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The fixed loan interest rate is 4.85%.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: The policyowner may elect to receive cash surrender proceeds.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Option
facts.sentence: The policyowner may elect to convert the policy to reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: No partial withdrawals allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals from the policy are not permitted.

facts.name: First Death Service Review Option
facts.sentence: At first death, the policyowner may request a service review.

facts.name: Service Review Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of the service review is to assess whether remaining premium deposits are sufficient to maintain the policy for the life expectancy of the surviving insured.

facts.name: Service Review Assumptions
facts.sentence: Current assumptions are used in determining sufficiency during the service review.

facts.name: Service Review Limitation
facts.sentence: The service review is informational only.

facts.name: Service Review Limitation
facts.sentence: The service review does not guarantee future policy performance.

facts.name: Supplement Premium Deposit
facts.sentence: The policyowner may choose to supplement the premium deposit account.

facts.name: Direct Premium Payment Option
facts.sentence: The policyowner may choose to pay premiums directly.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable annually for life.

facts.name: Premium Payment Terms
facts.sentence: Annual premiums are payable unless the policy is surrendered.

facts.name: Premium Payment Continuity
facts.sentence: Annual premiums are payable unless the policy is converted to reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: Premium Payment Conditions
facts.sentence: Annual premiums are payable unless the policy is otherwise supported by policy values.

facts.name: Policy Support Not Guaranteed
facts.sentence: Support of the policy through policy values is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for premium payment is 61 days.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability Limit
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, the insurer's liability is limited to premiums paid minus policy debt.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: The contestability period begins upon policy issue and lasts for two years.

facts.name: No War Exclusion Applies
facts.sentence: No war exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Absence
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Liability Limitation Clause
facts.sentence: Our liability is limited to premiums paid less debt.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: The contestability period is two years after issue.

facts.name: No War Exclusion
facts.sentence: No war exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No Aviation Exclusion
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Common Disaster Death Uncertainty
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same disaster, the order of death cannot be determined.

facts.name: Second-Death Payout Rule
facts.sentence: This policy will be treated as payable under the second-death provision when both insureds die in the same disaster and the order of death cannot be determined.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Changes
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Owner Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Borrow Against Policy
facts.sentence: The owner may borrow against the policy.

facts.name: Owner maintains deposit agreement
facts.sentence: The owner may maintain the premium deposit agreement.

facts.name: LLC Authority Verification
facts.sentence: We may require evidence of LLC authority before acting on any request.

facts.name: Free look policy return
facts.sentence: The owner may return this policy within thirty days after receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy upon return within thirty days after receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Right
facts.sentence: The owner may receive a refund of premiums paid under the policy upon cancellation.

facts.name: Premium Deposit Account Governance
facts.sentence: Treatment of the premium deposit account is governed by the separate deposit agreement.

facts.name: Annual Premium Mode
facts.sentence: The premium mode is annual.

facts.name: Life-Payable Premium Duration
facts.sentence: The premium duration is payable for life.

facts.name: Paid-Up Through Dividends
facts.sentence: The premium duration ends only if the policy becomes paid-up through dividends.

facts.name: Paid-Up Through Reduced Election
facts.sentence: The premium duration ends only if the policy becomes paid-up through a reduced paid-up election.

facts.name: Paid-Up Policy Termination Condition

facts.name: Survivorship Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a survivorship whole life policy.

facts.name: Survivorship Policy Structure
facts.sentence: This policy insures two persons under one contract.

facts.name: Survivorship Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a survivorship whole life policy.

facts.name: Dual Insured Policy
facts.sentence: The policy insures two persons under one contract.

facts.name: Second Death Trigger
facts.sentence: The death benefit is triggered only upon the death of the second insured to die.

facts.name: Second Death Trigger
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable at the first death.

facts.name: Survivorship Continuation Clause
facts.sentence: After the first death, the policy remains in force on the life of the surviving insured.

facts.name: Post-First Death Continuity
facts.sentence: After the first death, the policy remains in force subject to all premium, loan, and policy provisions.

facts.name: Estate Equalization Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy form is intended for estate equalization.

facts.name: Liquidity for Transfer Taxes
facts.sentence: This policy form is intended for liquidity for transfer taxes.

facts.name: Intergenerational Wealth Transfer
facts.sentence: This policy form is intended for intergenerational wealth transfer planning.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Upon the second death, the insurer will pay the then-current face amount.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Payout
facts.sentence: Upon the second death, the insurer will pay any paid-up additions.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Terms
facts.sentence: Upon the second death, the insurer will pay the total minus policy debt.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Terms
facts.sentence: Upon the second death, the insurer will pay the total minus accrued interest.

facts.name: Participating Policy Feature
facts.sentence: This policy is a participating policy.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends, if declared, are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Cash Dividend Option
facts.sentence: One dividend option is receiving dividends in cash.

facts.name: Dividend Option: Premium Reduction
facts.sentence: One dividend option is using dividends to reduce premiums.

facts.name: Dividend Accumulation Option
facts.sentence: One dividend option is leaving dividends to accumulate at interest.

facts.name: Dividend Option: Paid-Up Additions
facts.sentence: One dividend option is purchasing paid-up additions with dividends.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Increase Cash Value
facts.sentence: Paid-up additions increase cash value.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Increase Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Paid-up additions increase death benefit.

facts.name: Proof of Both Deaths Required
facts.sentence: Claim requirements include providing proof of the deaths of both insureds.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Claim requirements include submitting completed claim forms.

facts.name: Beneficiary Verification Requirements
facts.sentence: Claim requirements include providing any additional documentation reasonably required to establish beneficiary entitlement.

facts.name: Claim Settlement Timeline
facts.sentence: The insurer will normally settle the claim within 20 business days after receipt of complete and satisfactory proof.

facts.name: Premium Payment Schedule
facts.sentence: Premiums are due on each policy anniversary.

facts.name: Continuous-Pay Whole Life Structure
facts.sentence: This policy is designed on a continuous-pay whole life basis.

facts.name: Dividend Offset Limitation
facts.sentence: Premiums may be offset by dividends only to the extent permitted by the insurer's administrative rules then in effect.

facts.name: Premium Continuation Post-First Death
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies, premium obligations continue unless the policy has been converted to paid-up status.

facts.name: Grace Period for Premium Payment
facts.sentence: A premium not paid by its due date may be paid within 61 days after the due date.

facts.name: Grace Period for Premium Payment
facts.sentence: A premium not paid by its due date may be paid within 61 days after the due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period ends 61 days after the premium's due date.

facts.name: Policy Lapse After Grace Period
facts.sentence: If the premium remains unpaid after the grace period, the policy will lapse.

facts.name: Policy Lapse with Nonforfeiture Rights
facts.sentence: The policy will lapse subject to any nonforfeiture value available.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: This policy develops guaranteed cash value according to the policy schedule.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Policy loans are available after the first policy year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 92% of the available loan value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is fixed at 5.0% per annum.

facts.name: Loan Interest Accrual Rule
facts.sentence: Unpaid loan interest will be added to the loan principal.

facts.name: Policy Debt Reduction
facts.sentence: Policy debt reduces the amount payable at surrender or death.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: Cash surrender is a nonforfeiture option.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Option
facts.sentence: Reduced paid-up insurance is a nonforfeiture option.

facts.name: No Extended Term Option
facts.sentence: Extended term option is not available on this policy form.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not allowed.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Eligibility
facts.sentence: The owner may elect reduced paid-up insurance after the policy has acquired nonforfeiture values.

facts.name: First Death Notification Deadline
facts.sentence: At first death, the owner must notify the insurer within 90 days or as soon thereafter as reasonably possible.

facts.name: No Death Proceeds After First Death
facts.sentence: After the first death, no death proceeds are payable.

facts.name: Face Amount Stability Rule
facts.sentence: The face amount remains unchanged unless altered by policy debt, dividend election, or approved rider activity.

facts.name: Surviving Insured Ownership Condition
facts.sentence: The surviving insured does not become the owner unless the ownership arrangement separately provides for that result.

facts.name: Trust Ownership Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: We may require updated tax certifications if the policy is owned by a trust.

facts.name: Trust Ownership Requirement
facts.sentence: We may require trustee authority if the policy is owned by a trust.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Eligibility
facts.sentence: During the first 5 policy years, the owner may apply for an increase in coverage.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Underwriting
facts.sentence: A face amount increase application is subject to underwriting.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Rules
facts.sentence: A face amount increase application is subject to minimum issue rules.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Eligibility
facts.sentence: The Face Amount Increase Option is available during the first 5 policy years.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Underwriting
facts.sentence: An application for an increase in coverage under the Face Amount Increase Option is subject to underwriting review.

facts.name: Face Amount Increase Eligibility
facts.sentence: An application for an increase in coverage under the Face Amount Increase Option is subject to minimum issue rules.

facts.name: Guaranteed Purchase Option
facts.sentence: Rider Options may include a Guaranteed Purchase Option on the surviving life if elected and shown in the schedule.

facts.name: Additional Paid-Up Insurance Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Additional Paid-Up Insurance Rider may be included as a Rider Option if elected and shown in the schedule.

facts.name: Rider Availability Restriction
facts.sentence: Waiver of Monthly Deductions Rider is not available because this is not a Universal Life form.

facts.name: Separate Contestability for Increases
facts.sentence: Any increase in face amount approved after issue is separately contestable.

facts.name: Post-Issue Increase Suicide Limitation
facts.sentence: Any increase in face amount approved after issue is subject to a separate suicide limitation.

facts.name: Suicide Liability Limitation
facts.sentence: If an insured dies by suicide within 2 years after issue, liability is limited to total premiums paid minus any policy debt.

facts.name: Suicide Provision for Increased Coverage
facts.sentence: The suicide provision applies separately to the increased amount from its effective date when there is an increase in face amount.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy may be contested for material misrepresentation during the first 2 years after issue.

facts.name: Contestability While Insured Alive
facts.sentence: Contestability applies while at least one insured is alive.

facts.name: No War Exclusion
facts.sentence: No war exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No Terrorism Exclusion
facts.sentence: No terrorism exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Absence
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Trust Ownership Rights
facts.sentence: If this policy is owned by a dynasty trust, all owner rights are exercisable only by the acting trustee.

facts.name: Tax Estate Exclusion Responsibility
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for determining whether this policy is excluded from any taxable estate.

facts.name: Consult Tax Advisors on GST
facts.sentence: The owner should consult legal and tax advisors regarding generation-skipping transfer tax.

facts.name: Crummey Notice Guidance
facts.sentence: The owner should consult legal and tax advisors regarding Crummey notice procedures.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Restrictions Advisory
facts.sentence: The owner should consult legal and tax advisors regarding split-dollar restrictions.

facts.name: Immediate Death Benefit Payment
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same event and there is insufficient evidence of the order of death, the death benefit will be treated as due immediately.

facts.name: Survival Period Law Priority
facts.sentence: If applicable law requires a minimum survival period, that law controls unless this policy expressly provides otherwise.

facts.name: Immediate Death Benefit Payment
facts.sentence: Death triggers immediate payment of the death benefit.

facts.name: Survival Period Legal Priority
facts.sentence: If applicable law mandates a minimum survival period, that law governs unless the policy specifies otherwise.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign this policy via a written assignment.

facts.name: Written Assignment Filing Requirement
facts.sentence: A written assignment must be filed with Legacy Harbor Mutual Life.

facts.name: Assignment Recording Requirement
facts.sentence: An assignment must be recorded by Legacy Harbor Mutual Life to be effective.

facts.name: Assignment Binding Condition
facts.sentence: Legacy Harbor Mutual Life is not bound by any assignment until it is recorded.

facts.name: Assignment and Beneficiary Rights
facts.sentence: An assignment is subject to any existing beneficiary designation.

facts.name: Assignment Overrides Beneficiary
facts.sentence: An assignment can exclude the effect of an existing beneficiary designation only if the assignment states so.

facts.name: Assignment overrides beneficiary
facts.sentence: An assignment can exclude the effect of an existing beneficiary designation only if permitted by law.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may return this policy within 30 days after receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Right
facts.sentence: Returning the policy within 30 days entitles the owner to a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: Legacy Harbor Mutual Life is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware.

facts.name: CEO Title Confirmation
facts.sentence: The president and chief executive officer of Legacy Harbor Mutual Life holds the title 'President and Chief Executive Officer'.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is GSL-SWL-2026-1187.

facts.name: Issue Date Specification
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is February 3, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Limited Pay Policy
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life - Limited Pay.

facts.name: First Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The first insured is Robert Chen Ellsworth.

facts.name: Insured Birthdate
facts.sentence: Robert Chen Ellsworth's date of birth is October 14, 1959.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: Robert Chen Ellsworth's age at issuance is 66.

facts.name: Gender of First Insured
facts.sentence: Robert Chen Ellsworth's sex is male.

facts.name: Risk Classification: Standard Non-Tobacco
facts.sentence: Robert Chen Ellsworth's risk class is Standard Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Second Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The second insured is Margaret Lee Ellsworth.

facts.name: Date of Birth: Margaret Lee Ellsworth
facts.sentence: Margaret Lee Ellsworth's date of birth is June 2, 1961.

facts.name: Age of Second Insured at Issuance
facts.sentence: Margaret Lee Ellsworth's age at issuance is 64.

facts.name: Gender of Second Insured
facts.sentence: Margaret Lee Ellsworth's sex is female.

facts.name: Risk Classification: Standard Non-Tobacco
facts.sentence: Margaret Lee Ellsworth's risk class is Standard Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Joint Policy Ownership
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Robert Chen Ellsworth and Margaret Lee Ellsworth, jointly.

facts.name: Right of Survivorship Ownership
facts.sentence: The policy owners hold their ownership interest with right of survivorship.

facts.name: Ownership Change Requirement
facts.sentence: Ownership interests can be changed only through written amendment.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is the Ellsworth Children Education and Legacy Trust.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is equal shares among living descendants of the insureds.

facts.name: Per Stirpes Distribution Rule
facts.sentence: Benefit distribution to contingent beneficiaries follows per stirpes allocation.

facts.name: Face Amount: $1.8M
facts.sentence: The face amount of the policy is $1,800,000.

facts.name: Guaranteed Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The guaranteed annual premium is $58,950.

facts.name: 15-Year Premium Period
facts.sentence: The premium period lasts for 15 policy years only.

facts.name: Paid-Up Date Condition
facts.sentence: The paid-up date occurs on the 15th policy anniversary.

facts.name: Paid-Up Date Requirement
facts.sentence: The paid-up date condition requires all premiums due up to that point to have been paid.

facts.name: Survivorship Coverage Structure
facts.sentence: The policy insures two people under one survivorship whole life contract.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: The death benefit is paid only upon the second death.

facts.name: First Death Does Not Terminate Policy
facts.sentence: The death of the first insured does not terminate the policy.

facts.name: No Automatic Premium Waiver Post-First Death
facts.sentence: After the first death, no additional premiums are waived unless specified in a rider attached to the policy.

facts.name: Family Legacy Planning
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for family legacy planning.

facts.name: Charitable Giving Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for charitable giving.

facts.name: Liquidity Planning Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for liquidity planning.

facts.name: Annual Premiums for 15 Years
facts.sentence: Premiums are due annually for 15 policy years.

facts.name: Fully Paid-Up Status
facts.sentence: No premium is due after the 15th policy anniversary if all required premiums have been paid when due or within the grace period.

facts.name: First Death During Pay Period
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies during the premium-paying period, the remaining scheduled premiums remain due.

facts.name: Fully Paid-Up Death Benefit Continuity
facts.sentence: If the policy is in force and fully paid-up, the death benefit continues for life on a survivorship basis without further premium.

facts.name: No Skipping Premiums Except via Dividends
facts.sentence: Premiums may not be skipped during the 15-pay period except by using available dividend values when permitted by the insurer.

facts.name: Base Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The base death benefit is $1,800,000.

facts.name: Loan Balance Reduction
facts.sentence: Any outstanding loan balance reduces the amount payable as part of the death benefit.

facts.name: Loan Interest Reduces Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Accrued interest on any outstanding loan balance reduces the amount payable as part of the death benefit.

facts.name: Death Benefit Settlement Option
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may choose a lump-sum payment as a method of death benefit settlement.

facts.name: Interest-Only Settlement Option
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may choose an interest-only settlement for up to 5 years as a method of death benefit settlement.

facts.name: Death Benefit Settlement Options
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may choose fixed installment payments under an option agreement as a method of death benefit settlement.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of death is required for both insured individuals before death benefit settlement.

facts.name: Beneficiary Verification Requirement
facts.sentence: Reasonable evidence of beneficiary entitlement is required before death benefit settlement.

facts.name: Trust Authority Verification
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary is a trust, certification of trust authority may be required before settlement.

facts.name: Scheduled Paid-Up Addition Rider
facts.sentence: This policy includes a scheduled paid-up addition rider for the first 10 policy years.

facts.name: Optional Premiums Limit
facts.sentence: The rider permits optional additional premiums up to the maximum amount accepted by the insurer without creating modified endowment contract status.

facts.name: Premium Limit Based on Insurer Knowledge
facts.sentence: The maximum amount accepted by the insurer without creating modified endowment contract status is based on information available to the insurer at the time of payment.

facts.name: Paid-Up Insurance Boosts Cash Value
facts.sentence: Additional paid-up insurance increases cash value.

facts.name: Paid-Up Insurance Boosts Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Additional paid-up insurance increases the total death benefit.

facts.name: Excess Payment Decline
facts.sentence: The insurer may decline excess unscheduled payments.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Disclosure
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash values are shown in the policy schedule.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Loans are available after the policy has been in force for one full policy year.

facts.name: Loan Value Limitation
facts.sentence: Maximum loan value is 90% of net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Fixed loan interest rate is 4.75% per annum.

facts.name: Unpaid Loan Interest Added to Debt
facts.sentence: Loan interest not paid when due will be added to policy debt.

facts.name: No Partial Surrenders Allowed
facts.sentence: This policy does not permit partial surrenders.

facts.name: Default Nonforfeiture Option
facts.sentence: If premium is not paid by the end of the grace period, and this policy has cash value, the default nonforfeiture option will be reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: Written Election Required
facts.sentence: Another nonforfeiture option can only replace the default if elected in writing.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: The owner may elect cash surrender instead of reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: No Extended Term Insurance Available
facts.sentence: Extended term insurance is not available under this limited-pay survivorship whole life form.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability Limit
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after the issue date, the insurer's liability is limited to premiums paid minus any indebtedness.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: The insurer may contest this policy during the first two years after issue for material misrepresentation.

facts.name: Aviation Death Exclusion
facts.sentence: Aviation-related deaths are excluded from coverage.

facts.name: War Death Exclusion
facts.sentence: War-related deaths are excluded from coverage.

facts.name: Liability Limitation Clause
facts.sentence: The liability of Granite States Life Company is limited to premiums paid minus any indebtedness.

facts.name: Policy Contestability Period
facts.sentence: Granite States Life Company may contest this policy during the first two years after issuance due to material misrepresentation.

facts.name: No Aviation Exclusion
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No War Exclusion
facts.sentence: No war exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Residence Exclusion
facts.sentence: No foreign residence exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: No travel exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Joint Ownership Signature Requirement
facts.sentence: During the lifetime of both insureds, any ownership action requires signatures from both joint owners.

facts.name: Alternative Ownership Instruction Acceptance
facts.sentence: If an alternative instruction regarding ownership actions has been previously filed with Granite States Life Company, they may accept it instead of dual signatures.

facts.name: Survivor Ownership Rights
facts.sentence: After the first death of either insured, the surviving joint owner may exercise ownership rights.

facts.name: Survivorship Rights Override
facts.sentence: Ownership rights cease to belong to the surviving joint owner if ownership has already passed via assignment.

facts.name: Survivor Ownership Limitation
facts.sentence: Ownership rights cease to belong to the surviving joint owner if ownership has already passed via court order.

facts.name: Changing Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: Owner rights include the ability to change beneficiaries on the policy.

facts.name: Borrowing Against Policy
facts.sentence: Owner rights include the ability to borrow against the policy.

facts.name: Right to Assign Policy
facts.sentence: Owner rights include the ability to assign the policy.

facts.name: Right to Surrender Policy
facts.sentence: Owner rights include the ability to surrender the policy.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Benefit
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in a common disaster and the order of death cannot be determined, the death benefit will be payable as though both deaths occurred simultaneously.

facts.name: Survival Period & Payout Trigger
facts.sentence: If one insured survives the other by fewer than 15 days, the second death is treated as the triggering event for payout purposes.

facts.name: One Death Benefit Payable
facts.sentence: Only one death benefit is payable when one insured survives the other by less than 15 days.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy within 20 days after receiving it.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: A full refund of all premiums paid is available if the policy is canceled within 20 days of receipt.

facts.name: Company Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: Granite States Life Company is headquartered in Concord, New Hampshire.

facts.name: Effective Date
facts.sentence: The effective date of this document is February 3, 2026.

facts.name: CEO Signature Confirmation
facts.sentence: The Chief Executive Officer of Granite States Life Company signed this document.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is AML-S2D-2026-3375.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is March 10, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Structure
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The first insured is Daniel Thomas Avery.

facts.name: Birth Date of First Insured
facts.sentence: Daniel Thomas Avery was born on January 3, 1957.

facts.name: Insured Age: Daniel Avery
facts.sentence: Daniel Thomas Avery is 69 years old.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Daniel Thomas Avery's risk class is Preferred.

facts.name: Second Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The second insured is Linda Marie Avery.

facts.name: Birthdate of Linda Marie Avery
facts.sentence: Linda Marie Avery was born on September 27, 1960.

facts.name: Linda Avery's Age
facts.sentence: Linda Marie Avery is 65 years old.

facts.name: Risk Classification: Standard Plus
facts.sentence: Linda Marie Avery's risk class is Standard Plus.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Avery Family Holding Partnership, LP.

facts.name: Beneficiary Conditionality
facts.sentence: The beneficiary is Avery Family Foundation if the foundation exists at the time of the second death.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Clause
facts.sentence: If Avery Family Foundation does not exist at the time of the second death, the beneficiary is Avery Family Holding Partnership, LP.

facts.name: Base Face Amount
facts.sentence: The base face amount of the policy is $4,200,000.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The planned annual premium for the policy is $76,000.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Component
facts.sentence: The policy includes a guaranteed whole life cash value component.

facts.name: Indexed Dividend Enhancement
facts.sentence: The policy includes an indexed dividend enhancement feature.

facts.name: Survivorship Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a survivorship whole life insurance policy.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The death benefit under this policy is payable only upon the death of the second insured.

facts.name: No Payout on First Death
facts.sentence: No policy proceeds are payable upon the death of the first insured.

facts.name: Post-First Death Rights Retention
facts.sentence: Following the first death, all policy rights remain vested in the owner of record.

facts.name: Participating Policy Status
facts.sentence: This policy is participating.

facts.name: Indexed Dividend Enhancement
facts.sentence: An indexed dividend enhancement amount may be credited if declared by Atlantic Meridian Life.

facts.name: Indexed Dividend Enhancement Mechanism
facts.sentence: The indexed dividend enhancement is based on a designated broad-market index.

facts.name: Indexed Dividend Participation
facts.sentence: The indexed dividend enhancement is subject to a participation factor.

facts.name: Indexed Dividend Floor Protection
facts.sentence: The indexed dividend enhancement is subject to a zero percent floor.

facts.name: Indexed Dividend Cap
facts.sentence: The indexed dividend enhancement is subject to a maximum cap.

facts.name: Indexed Enhancement Not Guaranteed
facts.sentence: The indexed enhancement is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Index Performance Protection
facts.sentence: Negative index performance will not reduce guaranteed cash values that are already provided by the base policy.

facts.name: Indexed Enhancement Purchase Rule
facts.sentence: Any declared indexed enhancement will automatically purchase paid-up additions unless Atlantic Meridian Life permits another dividend option.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Enhancement
facts.sentence: Enhancement is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Protection
facts.sentence: Negative index performance will not reduce guaranteed cash values already provided by the base policy.

facts.name: Indexed Enhancement Allocation
facts.sentence: Any declared indexed enhancement will purchase paid-up additions unless another dividend option is permitted.

facts.name: Death Benefit Formula
facts.sentence: The death benefit equals the base face amount plus paid-up additions.

facts.name: Final Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The death benefit minus policy debt and accrued interest determines the final death benefit payout.

facts.name: Proof of Both Deaths Required
facts.sentence: Claim payment requires proof of both deaths.

facts.name: Beneficiary Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Claim payment requires satisfactory beneficiary documentation.

facts.name: Request Partnership Resolutions
facts.sentence: We may request partnership resolutions from the owner or beneficiary.

facts.name: Request for Authority Documents
facts.sentence: We may request authority documents from the owner or beneficiary.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: Planned annual premium is $76,000.

facts.name: Current Assumptions Basis Design
facts.sentence: The policy is designed on a current assumptions basis.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Values
facts.sentence: The policy includes guaranteed minimum values.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Enhancement Values
facts.sentence: The policy includes non-guaranteed enhancement values.

facts.name: Life-long premium payments
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable for life.

facts.name: Lifetime Premiums Conditioned on Self-Support
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable for life unless the policy becomes self-supporting according to then-current non-guaranteed values.

facts.name: Policy Self-Support Not Guaranteed
facts.sentence: We do not guarantee that the policy will become self-supporting.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: Grace period is 62 days.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Surrender Value
facts.sentence: The policy accumulates guaranteed cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Loans are available beginning in policy year 2.

facts.name: Max Loan Amount Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 95% of net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Variable Loan Rate
facts.sentence: Variable loan rate is currently 5.85% per annum.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may collateralize the policy by filing an assignment with us.

facts.name: First Death Advance Benefit
facts.sentence: If elected at issue and shown in the schedule, the owner may receive an advance benefit of $150,000 at first death.

facts.name: First-Death Advance Reduction
facts.sentence: Any first-death advance reduces the death benefit otherwise payable at second death.

facts.name: First-Death Advance Not Separate Benefit
facts.sentence: The first-death advance is not a separate death benefit.

facts.name: First-death advance non-termination
facts.sentence: The first-death advance does not terminate the policy.

facts.name: Suicide Contingency Clause
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within 2 years after issue, our liability is limited to premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Death Liability Reduction
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within 2 years after issue, our liability is reduced by policy debt.

facts.name: Contestability Period for Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: We may contest this policy for material misrepresentation during the first 2 years after issue.

facts.name: Hazardous Occupation Exclusion Absent
facts.sentence: No hazardous occupation exclusion applies.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Continuity
facts.sentence: If the named charitable beneficiary has ceased to exist at the second death, proceeds will be paid to the contingent beneficiary on file.

facts.name: Tax-Deductibility Responsibility Limitation
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for determining tax-deductibility.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Payout
facts.sentence: If the named charitable beneficiary has ceased to exist at the second death, proceeds will be paid to the contingent beneficiary on file.

facts.name: Tax-Deductibility Responsibility
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for determining tax-deductibility of the named charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Charitable Qualification Disclaimer
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for determining charitable qualification of the named charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Rule
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same occurrence, the order of death cannot be determined.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Claim Processing
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same occurrence and the order of death cannot be determined, the claim will be processed as a valid second-death claim.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Claim Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of both deaths is required to process a claim under Article IX.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation
facts.sentence: This policy may be returned within 30 days after delivery.

facts.name: Policy Cancellation Within 30 Days
facts.sentence: A return of this policy within 30 days after delivery results in cancellation.

facts.name: Policy Refund Within 30 Days
facts.sentence: A return of this policy within 30 days after delivery results in a refund.

facts.name: Guaranteed No-Lapse Survivorship
facts.sentence: The policy is titled Guaranteed No-Lapse Survivorship Whole Life Policy.

facts.name: Issuing Company
facts.sentence: The issuing company is Commonwealth Heritage Life.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is CHL-GNS-2026-4702.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is April 1, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Type
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The first insured is Steven Paul Morrison.

facts.name: Insured Birthdate Confirmation
facts.sentence: Steven Paul Morrison was born on May 4, 1958.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: Steven Paul Morrison is 67 years old at the time of issuance.

facts.name: Standard Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Steven Paul Morrison's risk class is Standard.

facts.name: Second Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The second insured is Diane Ruth Morrison.

facts.name: Date of Birth: Diane Morrison
facts.sentence: Diane Ruth Morrison was born on November 11, 1960.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: Diane Ruth Morrison is 65 years old at the time of issuance.

facts.name: Standard Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Diane Ruth Morrison's risk class is Standard.

facts.name: Policy Owner Designation
facts.sentence: The policy owner is the Morrison Family Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The beneficiary is the Morrison Family Insurance Trust.

facts.name: $5 Million Coverage
facts.sentence: The specified amount of coverage is $5,000,000.

facts.name: Guaranteed Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The guaranteed annual premium is $92,300.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Duration
facts.sentence: The no-lapse guarantee period extends to the joint attained age of 100 for the two insureds.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Conditions
facts.sentence: The no-lapse guarantee period is subject to cumulative premium requirements.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Structure
facts.sentence: This policy is a second-to-die whole life policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Protection via Premium Payments
facts.sentence: The policy provides guaranteed protection when required premiums are paid.

facts.name: Joint Death Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: Death proceeds are payable only after both insureds have died.

facts.name: First Insured Death No Claim
facts.sentence: The death of the first insured does not trigger a death claim.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Condition
facts.sentence: The policy will remain in force during the no-lapse guarantee period if cumulative premiums paid equal or exceed the required guarantee premium amount.

facts.name: Required Premium in Schedule
facts.sentence: The required guarantee premium amount is shown in the schedule.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Independence
facts.sentence: The no-lapse guarantee operates independently of actual cash value.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Validity
facts.sentence: The no-lapse guarantee remains effective as long as all other conditions are satisfied.

facts.name: Loan Impact on No-Lapse Guarantee
facts.sentence: Loans taken against the policy do not terminate the no-lapse guarantee.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee & Loan Interest
facts.sentence: Unpaid loan interest does not terminate the no-lapse guarantee.

facts.name: Loan Debt Limit Termination
facts.sentence: Loan-related termination occurs only if policy debt exceeds the maximum amount permitted.

facts.name: Post-Guarantee Coverage Condition
facts.sentence: After the end of the no-lapse guarantee period, coverage continues only if sufficient net cash value remains.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The death benefit is equal to the specified amount minus policy debt.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: The death benefit is reduced by any unpaid charges authorized by the policy.

facts.name: Post-Guarantee Coverage Condition
facts.sentence: After the guarantee period, coverage continues only if sufficient net cash value remains.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: We will pay the specified amount less policy debt and unpaid charges authorized by this policy.

facts.name: Claim Processing Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of death is required to process a claim.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Completed claim documents are required to process a claim.

facts.name: Installment Settlement Interest
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary elects an installment settlement, interest will be credited at a rate determined by us.

facts.name: Installment Interest Minimum
facts.sentence: Interest credited under an installment settlement will not be below any legal minimum.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premiums are due annually on the policy anniversary.

facts.name: Minimum Annual Premium for Guarantee
facts.sentence: The annual premium shown above is the minimum premium required to maintain the guarantee on an annual-pay basis.

facts.name: Continued Premiums Post-First Death
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies, guarantee premiums must continue to be paid to preserve the no-lapse guarantee.

facts.name: Grace Period for Premium Payment
facts.sentence: A grace period of 60 days applies to premium payment.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Growth
facts.sentence: This policy develops limited guaranteed cash value during the no-lapse guarantee period.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Loans are available beginning in year 3.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit Based on Cash Value
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 85% of net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Fixed loan interest rate is 6.0% per annum.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted.

facts.name: Survivorship Rider Extension
facts.sentence: If this survivorship lapse protection rider is shown in the schedule, and one insured dies during the guarantee period, an additional 12-month extension is granted for any unpaid premium due immediately after that first death.

facts.name: Rider Does Not Waive Premium Permanently
facts.sentence: The survivorship lapse protection rider does not waive premium permanently.

facts.name: Rider Expiration Post-First Death
facts.sentence: The survivorship lapse protection rider expires after the first death.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within 2 years after issue, liability is limited to premiums paid less debt.

facts.name: Contestability Period Clause
facts.sentence: We may contest this policy within 2 years after issue for material misrepresentation.

facts.name: No War Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy has no war exclusion.

facts.name: No Terrorism Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy has no terrorism exclusion.

facts.name: Trustee Authority Limitation
facts.sentence: All owner rights are exercisable only by the acting trustee.

facts.name: Trust Certification Reliance
facts.sentence: We may rely on any trust certification furnished to us.

facts.name: Trust Verification Limitation
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for determining whether the trust is irrevocable.

facts.name: Trust Tax Effectiveness Responsibility
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for determining whether the trust is tax-effective.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Policy Maturity
facts.sentence: If both insureds die from the same disaster and evidence does not establish the order of death, the policy is treated as matured.

facts.name: Trust Types
facts.sentence: The trust can be either irrevocable or tax-effective.

facts.name: Common Disaster Definition
facts.sentence: If both insureds die from the same disaster, that event constitutes a common disaster.

facts.name: Order of Death Determination
facts.sentence: Evidence may be used to determine the order of death of the insureds.

facts.name: Undetermined Death Order
facts.sentence: If evidence does not establish the order of death of the insureds, the order of death is undetermined.

facts.name: Second Death Maturity Rule
facts.sentence: When the order of death cannot be established due to a common disaster, the policy shall be treated as matured by second death.

facts.name: Owner Return Right
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy has the right to return the policy.

facts.name: Free Look Period Duration
facts.sentence: The period during which the owner may return the policy is 30 days after receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Window
facts.sentence: Returning the policy within 30 days after receipt allows for cancellation of the policy.
